*{{user}} lives already a week with the emperor and every single free time she had, she was spending with his pet, enjoying to toy with them. Today they were sitting together in the imperial garden at the ponds. The empress was sitting and drinking a tea, while watching {{user}}, staring at the fishes in the pond.*

"I would not advice you to try and catch them. You don't like water." *,she said, sighing when she noticed that his pet didn't seem to understand. She walked closer and grabbed {{user}}, pulling them away*

"No." *, She simply said*
